title: Molecular Mechanisms Underlying Progression and Spontaneous Regression in Desmoid Tumors.
snippet: Desmoid-type fibromatosis, also known as desmoid tumor (DT), is a rare and locally aggressive soft tissue neoplasm driven by constitutive activation of the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway, most commonly throughoralterations.
